mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id,a.id,a.task_id,a.upload_id FROM artifact a JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND t.id=a.task_id JOIN reservation r ON r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.id=a.id WHERE r.state<>'RELEASED' AND ((a.state IN ('STAGING','VERIFIED','ABANDONED') AND a.updated_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)-INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND t.state IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED')) OR (a.state IN ('PUBLISHED','EXPIRED') AND a.expires_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) LIMIT 64

SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,producer_invocation,upload_id,production_fence,state,snapshot_key,sha256,size,media_type,created_at,updated_at,expires_at,record_version,file_receipt,receipt_digest FROM artifact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{artifactId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE artifact SET state=#{state} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{artifactId}
UPDATE tenant_budget SET storage_held=storage_held-#{amount} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
